R7AA-bear-backcountry-0002.name: 1.9 km NE of West Road (Blackwater) River
R7AA-bear-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2014 (12 years old), 430 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2021 (fire C11491), 90 m S: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
Unnamed wetland right here: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: North Chilcotin. Closed September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-3/23.
Route crosses provincial park: Kluskoil Lake Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: Bag 2; parts of MU 5-9 are closed to black bear hunting (Map F14, page 52) and the Mussel Inlet Special Management Area in MU 5-9 has no black bear season (page 43)

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 123 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.17781, -123.85016, pull off on Chi028.1000 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 88 m, about 117 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m NE of the spot at 971 m (53.21826, -123.8017). Water: unnamed wetland 80 m SW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-13, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-bear-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-13: about 1,446 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.10 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
